test a weighted combination with inverse_error weights to see if error‐based weighting beats the robust mean in this trend‑dominated series.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 1.0. Series context: trend strength 0.9803 and seasonal strength 0.365; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.162); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.962.
